z: The largest of their flocks can contain more than 50 individuals. They fly around towns and forests, searching for food and making a racket.
Blue-feathered Squawkabilly view their green- feathered counterparts as rivals, since the latter make up the largest, most powerful groups.
Squawkabilly with blue plumage are the second most populous variety after their green counterparts, which they view as foes.
